nonblocking_observations.detail: M4/M5 close the exact ResolvedStructuralContext interface/signature without fabricating a runtime context instance; actual context_id/content_hash remains required at runtime consumption.
Accepted SCRV3 has zero positive actor-transition PSEPF read rows. M5 treats empirical geometry dereference as noncausal and does not revive earlier feeder suggestions.
Final reclosure may recommend HQ open a separately governed implementation gate; it does not itself authorize production code, source retirement, deployment, or implementation activation.
